scope: Separate nominal protective-skirt and frame-channel candidate. Both cartridges retain their connector contact geometry, shell keys and seating pose; this is not a production or continuous-insertion qualification.
units: millimetres; X/Y relative to each cartridge socket centre, Z from motherboard datum
limitations: The skirt and channel are separate design candidates, not modifications of the retained cartridge or frame models.
Sampled straight insertion positions do not establish continuous motion, tilted insertion or contact forces.
Tolerance stacks, frame strength, skirt strength, moulding, wear and reversed insertion remain to be established.
No PCB, connector, contact, shell-key or software change is implied.
